title: 第8章 收尾
novel_title: 手握旧日权柄，弹幕硬说我是主角(灰烬暗燃)
content_zh: 见许牧重复握拳的动作，面具人有些好笑地呵了一声道：“别比划了，放心，没有问题。”行吧，算你还靠点谱……不用办残疾证了。许牧悬着的心落地，平静道：“谢了，帮了大忙。”“嗨，不用！在集体潜意识空间里你也救过我。”面具人拿起李桃的超凡遗留物，看向许牧道，“不过，这个我得带走。”你看我干什么，反正硬抢我也打不过你……许牧摆手道：“你随意，我用不到。”不等面具人接话，他用半开玩笑半试探的语气道：“不过，莫名其妙被拉进集体潜意识空间充当打手，有没有报酬？”他本来睡得好好的，突然就被卷入超凡事件，用断手的代价才勉强活命，虽然最后手又回来了，也学到了一些超凡知识，但没点实质性的收获，总觉得亏麻了。面具人似乎早有预料，当即脱口道：“有！当然有！我们做事，最讲公平！从我身上摸走的四枚符咒就送你了。”我们？对了，他说过他背后有一个组织……思索同时，许牧也终于知道了那四枚金属牌原来叫符咒。“你先等一下。”面具人动作很轻地拉开背包，从里面掏出两捆很有份量的钞票。由于贫困所迫，许牧对金钱的感知力异常清晰，他打眼一过就知道那足足有二十万新元！这是给我的？我一个临时工都有二十万，那他这个正式员工得有多少？这么有钱……阁下的组织还招人吗？许牧突然觉得这一趟赚麻了。许牧伸出手，准备去接过那两捆钞票，却发现面具人把钞票轻轻摆放于李桃的床头柜，然后以手按胸，对女孩深深鞠了一躬。见此，许牧刚抬到半空的手立刻改变轨迹，伸于面前，尴尬地挠了挠鼻尖，看向床上安静躺着的李桃。是啊，她也是受害者……一个完整的家庭就这么破碎了，而导致这一切的幕后人此刻或许在灯红酒绿，或许在歌舞升平。虽然有些许动容，但许牧并没有认为自已和面具人是杀人凶手。做完一切，两人轻手轻脚地离开401。“关于报酬，你想要金钱还是其他东西？”402室客厅内，面具人坐在沙发上，翘着腿问道。许牧思考两秒，沉声反问道：“金钱的话能给多少？”“由于这是我的失误，不能向组织申请额外费用，只能由我个人承担。”面具人双手抱在胸前，摩挲手指道，“我现在最多能拿出1万新元。”“当然，这肯定不够，后续我会尽快攒够9万，一共10万，怎么样？”看来你的经济状况也不比我强多少，而且万一你跑了，我去哪找剩下的9万……许牧摇了摇头，转而说道：“这样吧，你给我1万新元，外加回答我一个问题，普通人要成为超凡者，除了最常见的方式，还有哪些途径？”至于最常见的方式是什么，我也不知道，但你肯定知道……许牧于心底补充道。他没有忘记这两天的主要目的：弄清楚普通人成为超凡者的方式。经历了集体潜意识空间事件后，许牧发现普通人可以被超凡灵性污染，从而成为超凡者，就像安琳和李桃一样。但这样的方式会导致被污染的人成为失控者，变成怪物，并不适合作为答案应付749。面具人抬手轻敲起面具，过了许久才回答道：“除了最常见的服食魔药，我还知道两种方法。一种就像安琳、李桃一样，被强行污染，成为失控的怪物；另一种，天生灵感过高的人，可以接触并沟通超凡灵性，从而让超凡灵性融于本身灵性，成为超凡者。”听完面具人的回答，许牧有了一个既能掩盖金手指，同时也能向749承认自已是超凡者的思路：我可以把自已伪装成一个灵感过高，但不自知的人，在对付完孕尸安琳后被动地沟通并融合了她逸散掉的超凡灵性，成为了超凡者。这样一来，不管是逻辑还是时间，都能对应上。许牧无声思量间，面具人放下翘起的二郎腿，正式道：“你问这个问题，其实是想打探超凡序列的晋升渠道吧。”这个真没有……许牧对他自作聪明的样子有些无语。见许牧不说话，面具人觉得自已猜对了，他以一种过来人的口吻道：“大多数野生超凡者的日子很难过，先不提序列晋升，性命能不能保证都是问题，我的建议是，尽快找个组织。”许牧听出了面具人的招揽意图，直接了当说道：“比如，加入你背后的组织？”面具人故作沉稳回道：“其实，我们的组织更倾向于收纳那些遭遇过极大不公平，且对生活绝望的人，而你不符合条件。”顿了顿，见许牧没什么表情，他转而嘿嘿笑道：“不过，如果你想加入，以我们共患难的交情，我可以向组织介绍你。”“不用了，我感觉现在这样很自由，不想加入组织。”许牧拒绝道。开玩笑，加入你们我还怎么加入749，怎么去主角身边混讨论度？面具人莞尔一笑：“话别说得太绝对，你刚成为超凡者不久，很多事情不了解，以后会改变看法的。”他从背包里拿出一沓钞票放于茶几上，起身整理了一下衣服道：“这是属于你的1万新元，现在我们的账平了。”说完，他抬起左手看了眼手表，把背包往肩上一甩，向着门口走去。“等等。”就在面具人的手即将搭上门把手时，许牧忽然出声打断了他。面具人收回胳膊，转身问道：“你这是改变主意，想加入我们的组织了？”“不是。”许牧没什么表情，平静道：“把那几枚符咒的效果告诉我，‘敏捷’的我已经用掉了，还剩‘雷电’和‘静谧’。”面具人啧了一声，快速回答道：“‘雷电’符咒激活后，3秒内扔向敌人，3秒后会发生雷电爆炸，威力还不错。‘静谧’符咒激活后，可以对外界隔绝屏蔽你发出的任何声音，效果10分钟。激活符咒的方法相信你已经知道了，蔓延灵性接触符咒，再念出咒文。”许牧轻轻点头，微笑道：“谢谢，再见。”
content_en: Seeing Xu Mu repeating the gesture of clenching his fist, the masked man let out a funny laugh and said, "Stop gesticulating, don't worry, there's no problem." Okay, I guess you're pretty good... you don't need to apply for a disability certificate.Xu Mu's heart dropped and he said calmly: "Thank you, it was a big help." "Hey, no need! You also saved me in the collective subconscious space." The masked man picked up Li Tao's extraordinary relics and looked at Xu Mu and said, "But I have to take this with me." Look at what I'm doing, I can't beat you anyway... Xu Mu waved his hand and said: "You can do whatever you want, I won't use it." Without waiting for the mask.When the person answered, he said in a half-joking and half-testing tone: "But, is there any reward for being pulled into the collective subconscious space for no reason and acting as a thug?" He was sleeping well, but suddenly he was involved in an extraordinary incident, and he barely survived at the cost of a broken hand. Although his hand came back in the end, and he learned some extraordinary knowledge, there was no substantial gain, and he always felt that he was at a loss.The masked man seemed to have expected it, and immediately blurted out: "Yes! Of course there is! We do things fairly! The four charms that were taken from me will be given to you." Us?By the way, he said that there was an organization behind him... At the same time as he was thinking about it, Xu Mu finally found out that the four metal plates were originally called talismans."Wait a moment." The masked man opened his backpack very gently and took out two bundles of substantial banknotes.Forced by poverty, Xu Mu has an extremely clear sense of money. He knew at a glance that it was a full two hundred thousand Singapore dollars!Is this for me?I have two hundred thousand as a temporary worker, so how much does he have as a regular employee?With so much money...is your organization still hiring?Xu Mu suddenly felt that this trip was a waste of money.Xu Mu stretched out his hand, ready to take the two bundles of banknotes, but found that the masked man gently placed the banknotes on Li Tao's bedside table, then pressed his hand on his chest and bowed deeply to the girl.Seeing this, Xu Mu's hand that had just been raised in the air immediately changed its trajectory, stretched out in front of him, scratched the tip of his nose awkwardly, and looked at Li Tao, who was lying quietly on the bed.Yes, she is also a victim... A complete family is broken like this, and the person behind all this may be feasting or singing and dancing at the moment.Although he was slightly moved, Xu Mu did not think that he and the masked man were murderers.After everything was done, the two left 401 quietly."As for the reward, do you want money or something else?" In the living room of Room 402, the masked man sat on the sofa and asked with his legs crossed.Xu Mu thought for two seconds and asked in a deep voice: "How much can I give you in terms of money?" "Because this is my mistake, I cannot apply for additional expenses from the organization and can only be borne by me personally." The masked man crossed his hands on his chest and rubbed his fingers and said, "The most I can come up with now is 10,000 Singapore dollars." "Of course, this is definitely not enough. I will save 90,000 as soon as possible, a total of 100,000. How about it?" It seems like your finances are good.The situation is not much better than mine, and if you run away, where will I find the remaining 90,000... Xu Mu shook his head and said instead: "Let's do this, you give me 10,000 Singapore dollars, plus answer me a question, besides the most common way, what are the other ways for ordinary people to become extraordinary?" As for the most common way, I don't know, but you must know... Xu Mu added in the bottom of his heart.He did not forget the main purpose of these two days: to find out how ordinary people become extraordinary.After experiencing the collective subconscious space incident, Xu Mu discovered that ordinary people can be contaminated by extraordinary spirituality and become extraordinary people, just like An Lin and Li Tao.However, this method will cause the contaminated people to become out of control and monsters, and is not suitable as an answer to deal with 749.The masked man raised his hand and tapped the mask, and after a long time he replied: "In addition to the most common method of taking magic potion, I also know two methods. One is like An Lin and Li Tao, who are forcibly contaminated and become out-of-control monsters; the other is that people who are born with too much inspiration can contact and communicate with extraordinary spirituality, so that the extraordinary spirituality can be integrated into their own spirituality and become a monster.A transcendent." After listening to the masked man's answer, Xu Mu came up with an idea that could cover up Goldfinger and at the same time admit to 749 that he was a transcendent: I could disguise myself as a person who was too inspired but didn't know it, and after dealing with the pregnant corpse An Lin, I passively communicated and integrated her lost transcendent spirituality, and became a transcendent.In this way, both logic and time can be matched.While Xu Mu was thinking silently, the masked man put down his crossed legs and said formally: "You ask this question because you actually want to find out about the promotion channels to the extraordinary sequence." This is really not the case... Xu Mu was speechless at his smart-aleck appearance.Seeing that Xu Mu didn't speak, the masked man felt that he had guessed it right. He said in an experienced tone: "Most wild extraordinary people have a very difficult life. Let's not mention the promotion of the sequence. Whether their lives can be guaranteed is still a problem. My suggestion is to find an organization as soon as possible." Xu Mu heard the masked man's recruitment intention and said directly: "For example, join the organization behind you?" The masked man pretended to be calm and replied: "In fact, our organization is more inclined to accept people who have experienced great injustice and are desperate for life, and you do not meet the conditions." After a pause, he turned to smile when Xu Mu showed no expression. "However, if you want to join, I can introduce you to the organization because of our mutual friendship." "No, I feel that it is very free now, and I don't want to join the organization."Just kidding, if I join you, how can I join 749? How can I get around the protagonist to gain discussion?The masked man smiled and said, "Don't be too absolute. You have just become a transcendent. You don't understand many things, and you will change your views in the future." He took out a wad of bills from his backpack and put it on the coffee table. He stood up, straightened his clothes and said, "This is your 10,000 Singapore dollars. Now our account is even." After saying that, he raised his left hand and looked at his watch, swung his backpack over his shoulder, and walked towards the door."Wait." Just when the masked man's hand was about to touch the door handle, Xu Mu suddenly interrupted him.The masked man retracted his arm, turned around and asked, "Have you changed your mind and want to join our organization?" "No." Xu Mu showed no expression and said calmly: "Tell me the effects of those spells. I have used the 'agility' ones, and I still have 'Thunder and Lightning' and 'Tranquility'." The masked man clicked his tongue and quickly replied: "The 'Thunder and Lightning' spell is activated.Then, throw it at the enemy within 3 seconds, and a thunder and lightning explosion will occur after 3 seconds.The power of the 'Quiet' spell can be blocked from the outside world for 10 minutes.I believe you already know the method of activating the spell, spread the spiritual contact spell, and then recite the spell." Xu Mu nodded lightly and said with a smile, "Thank you."
